name: zoho-mail-1.0.0
description: Read, search, move, and send emails via Zoho Mail. Connects through the Zoho MCP endpoint.

tools.name: zoho_list_folders
tools.description: List all Zoho Mail folders with message counts and unread counts. Use this to get folder IDs needed for other tools.

tools.name: zoho_list_emails
tools.description: List emails in a specific Zoho Mail folder. Returns subject, sender, date, read status, and message ID.

folder.description: Folder name or ID. Use common names: 'inbox', 'sent', 'trash', 'spam', 'newsletter', 'notification', 'hp', 'ui', 'le', 'ge'. Or pass a raw folder ID.

unread_only.description: If true, return only unread emails

tools.name: zoho_search_emails
tools.description: Search emails across all folders using Zoho search syntax. Supports from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, in:folder, is:unread, before:date, after:date.

query.description: Zoho search query. Examples: 'from:zeus subject:invoice', 'has:attachment is:unread', 'subject:tax after:2025-01-01'

tools.name: zoho_read_email
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific email by message ID. Returns subject, sender, recipients, date, and body text.

message_id.description: The Zoho message ID (from zoho_list_emails or zoho_search_emails)

tools.name: zoho_move_emails
tools.description: Move one or more emails to a different folder. Safe staging only — never deletes.

message_ids.description: List of message IDs to move

to_folder.description: Destination folder name or ID. Use: 'inbox', 'trash', 'spam', 'newsletter', 'notification', 'hp', 'ui', 'le', 'ge', or a raw folder ID.

tools.name: zoho_mark_read
tools.description: Mark one or more emails as read or unread.

message_ids.description: List of message IDs to mark

read.description: True to mark as read, false to mark as unread (default: true)

tools.name: zoho_send_email
tools.description: Send an email from Zeus's Zoho Mail account. Can send as any configured identity (HP, UI, LE, GE, Personal Brand, OneMind).

from_identity.description: Which send identity to use. hp=Holistic Performance, ui=Unified Intelligence, le=Legacy Evolution, ge=Generational Entrepreneurship, personal=Zeus Personal Brand, onemind=Zeus OneMind (finance@legacyhq.ai). Defaults to primary account.

tools.name: zoho_get_account_info
tools.description: Get Zoho Mail account overview: email aliases, send identities, storage usage, and folder summary.
